name: [Upd] Brainrot Battlegrounds
desc:
Welcome to the Brainrot Battlegrounds.
This is a Brainrot fighting game.
Use your brainrot to fight!!!

🎮📱🖥️ Supports all devices. (PC, console, mobile)

🖥️PC control
M1 - Normal combination
1,2,3,4 - Skill
F - Block
Q - Sprint

👍If you find it fun, give the game a thumbs up.
👋Join our community to receive update news.
